content_metadata.description: This video by OBE1plays covers new video game releases, a storyline leak, and an innovative Xbox project.

qAndA.question: What is the name of the new WWE game coming out in Fall 2020?

qAndA.answer: It includes a built-in projector that can project a high-resolution 8K HDR image of games onto any surface.
qAndA.question: What unusual feature is included in the "Xbox Project Oris" concept?

qAndA.answer: It was leaked by a disgruntled former developer who was allegedly unhappy with his compensation.
qAndA.question: How did the entire storyline of "The Last of Us 2" get leaked?

qAndA.answer: He wants gyro aiming to be added to the controller, similar to the feature on Nintendo Switch controllers.
qAndA.question: What specific feature does OBE1plays desire in future Xbox controllers?

qAndA.answer: The mood is very excited and energetic, fueled by the announcement of the new WWE game.

Reacting to gameplay footage of "WWE 2K Battlegrounds".
Discussing the leak of "The Last of Us 2" storyline.
Reacting to leaked footage of "The Last of Us 2".

mood.description: Excited. OBE1plays is very enthusiastic about the new game releases, especially "WWE 2K Battlegrounds" and "Xbox Project Oris".

keyMoments.changeDescription: His animated expressions and gestures change to a more serious tone with a slower pace.
Visuals and upbeat music create an energetic mood again.

narrativeProgression.description: OBE1plays starts by expressing excitement about the new video game news.
He announces the release of "WWE 2K Battlegrounds" and highlights its arcade-style gameplay.
He transitions to the news of the leaked "The Last of Us 2" storyline.
He excitedly reveals the concept of "Xbox Project Oris".
He briefly shares his thoughts on the new Xbox Series X controller.
He encourages viewers to subscribe and participate in his monthly giveaway.
